fieldNotes.site: Imagery captured mid-construction (Dec 2024 Street View; satellite shows building substantially complete with most of the site still bare graded dirt). Counts are honest projections for the completed facility, not finished-state observations.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Dedicated truck entrance on the SW corner off Farrell Rd: chain-link sliding gate across the truck lane with facility signage ('NORTH HOUS...'). A separate car/visitor entrance ~120m north is signed 'NO TRUCKS' and has a yellow barrier arm. Trucks have their own controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A modular/booth structure sits just inside the truck gate (visible in Street View). Likely doubles as construction office during build-out but is positioned as a gatehouse. Medium confidence given construction-era imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Refrigerated/freezer DC class building (rooftop refrigeration units visible). Dock doors line the long east face; band 50+ is a projection for a facility of this footprint and type.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large graded yard south and west of the building being built out as trailer parking; capacity 50+ projected.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance aprons and ample undeveloped paved width — clear room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-metro setting on a rural-feeling road (Farrell Rd) bordered by woods, a golf course (Lochinvar GC), and scattered rural homes. Classified Rural per rubric tie-break guidance.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in construction-era imagery; cannot rule out installation as the yard is completed.
